description: Background removal on one Spark: BiRefNet_HR-matting, the creator's matting variant of the HR model, which keeps soft edges such as fur, needles and fences. One PNG or JPEG up to 4096x4096 in; cutout.png (the input RGB with the predicted mask as alpha) and mask.png (8-bit grayscale) out at the input size. It runs the creator's model-card inference in fp16: a 2048x2048 resize, ImageNet normalisation, the last prediction through a sigmoid and the mask resized back to the input; there are no per-request knobs. Larger images are refused, never resized silently. The weights are MIT licensed. Memory is an estimate from the 0.44 GB of weights and the 2048x2048 activations; the hardware try decides.
title: BiRefNet HR matting cutout PyTorch single Spark
